payload.name: pc-transfer-07
payload.description: Pure-logic window classifier. Reads a raw window value from inputs and returns an explicit classification object: missing when the key is absent, null when the value is explicitly null, integer when it is an exact integer in 3..12, and invalid otherwise. No imports, I/O or host calls; returns an invalid-result object for malformed data instead of raising.
